video_title: LIVE: Pelicans vs. Grizzlies Pregame w/ Jamahl Mosley 11/02/2026

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley provides update on Dejounte Murray's absence
quotes.excerpt: he actually flew with us last night and then he actually had to fly back home
quotes.quote: He actually flew with us last night and then he actually had to fly back home this afternoon to be back home for personal reasons.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley confirms Dejounte Murray flew with the team last night but had to return home today for personal reasons.

structured.context: Head coach Jamahl Mosley explains that Dejounte Murray flew with the team but had to return home for personal reasons.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on defensive strategy against the Grizzlies
quotes.excerpt: Ty Jerome is playing unbelievable basketball right now, but they do a great job of sharing it
quotes.quote: Ty Jerome is playing unbelievable basketball right now, but they do a great job of sharing it, moving it, respacing the floor. So it's going to take a multiple effort from each one of our guys. Protect the paint first, and then we've got to get out to shooters. Another big portion of that is with our offense. We've got to make sure we're taking care of the basketball because they can turn you over with their pressure, and we don't want to give any easy baskets to them.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley says stopping the Grizzlies requires a multiple effort from every player to protect the paint and get out to shooters.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley discusses the defensive strategy required to contain Ty Jerome and the Grizzlies.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on maintaining defensive standards on the road
quotes.excerpt: you can't control whether shots go in or not, but you can control your effort
quotes.quote: That standard travels, no matter when, no matter where. You can't control whether shots go in or not, but you can control your effort. You can control being in the right space at the right time. You can control how much you communicate with your teammates, and then understanding the game plan, knowing who you're guarding, how you're closing out, who you're allowing to take a tough shot versus understanding exactly who they are on the floor.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley emphasizes that defensive standards must travel on the road regardless of whether shots are falling.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley emphasizes the importance of maintaining defensive standards and effort while playing on the road.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on the contagious nature of defensive energy
quotes.excerpt: those are things that that can spark your defense
quotes.quote: You saw the other night in Atlanta, how many hustle plays did we have, not giving up on a play? Whether we turned it over, there was a sprint back, there was diving on the floor. Those are things that that can spark your defense. Getting the 50-50 ball, creating a jump ball, that's contagious energy right there, and that just takes will and want, and then the ability for your teammates to get behind you there.
quotes.social_post: Hustle plays and diving for loose balls are contagious energy that can spark a defense according to Jamahl Mosley.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley describes how hustle plays and defensive energy can become contagious for the team.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on the impact of veterans Isaiah Stewart and Jeremy Grant
quotes.excerpt: Isaiah and Jeremy, they bring a level of toughness, experience
quotes.quote: Isaiah and Jeremy, they bring a level of toughness, experience, but just knowing how they can protect the paint. Jeremy who's able to guard multiple positions, I think it's great. Stew does a great job of protecting the rim, so another big body there that's not afraid to mix it up a little bit. I think those are very good veterans for them to add to their team.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley praises the impact of veterans Isaiah Stewart and Jeremy Grant for their toughness and rim protection.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley praises the toughness and defensive contributions of veterans Isaiah Stewart and Jeremy Grant.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on balancing team principles with game-specific adjustments
quotes.excerpt: establishing our principles is going to be a key for us
quotes.quote: Our standard of play for defense is going to be the same, and obviously there's going to be things that teams do that we work on taking away. If a player gets hot, how we can adjust to it, but establishing our principles is going to be a key for us, six games in. But then as we start to understand the game plan more and more, how do we get it out of a hot player's hands? How do we rotate differently? How do we post double team?
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley says establishing defensive principles is the key priority for his team six games into the season.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley explains the balance between sticking to defensive principles and making game-specific adjustments.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on the responsibility of coaching young players who are becoming fathers
quotes.excerpt: we are stewards for these young men to understand what it means to be men and fathers
quotes.quote: The business of basketball is wins and losses, I completely understand that, I never want to take that away. But the business of life is that we are stewards for these young men to understand what it means to be men and fathers in a lot of these moments. And we've talked about it as an organization, as a group, as a staff. You're brought here to help these young men understand what it means to be so many things, not just at home and on the court, but in the community.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley reflects on the role of coaches as stewards for young players navigating life as men and fathers.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley reflects on the responsibility of the coaching staff to mentor young players in their personal lives.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on Bryce's professionalism and toughness
quotes.excerpt: Bryce has continued to show what it means to be a professional
quotes.quote: Bryce has continued to show what it means to be a professional, and I use that term a lot for guys that are willing to just continue to put the work in whether they're playing two minutes, ten minutes, or no minutes. And he has done that. He has shown through camp how professional he is, stays late, shows up early, and then he has a level of toughness that people don't really register and recognize that he's not afraid to mix it up at any given moment.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley highlights the professionalism and toughness of Bryce, noting he is not afraid to mix it up at any given moment.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley commends the professionalism and toughness shown by Bryce during training camp.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on the source of Ty's offensive danger
quotes.excerpt: the first thing that makes him so dangerous is his confidence level
quotes.quote: The first thing that makes him so dangerous is his confidence level. He is not afraid of any given moment at any given time. And I've seen him before when he was in Cleveland, he had spark moments for them as well. And when he got off the injured injury report, he's just coming, he gets downhill, he's not afraid of any shot and will take any shot anywhere at any given time. But then the level of confidence that he has as a player is extremely high.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley identifies the high confidence level of Ty Jerome as the primary reason he is so dangerous on the floor.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley analyzes the factors behind Ty Jerome's high confidence and offensive effectiveness.
